pages.title: Catalysts
pages.text: $(thing)Every machine needs a core$(). Not a part, a $(thing)catalyst$(). Lay the same stone around another core and it becomes another machine.$(br2)The frame is clay. The core is the hand that shapes it.

pages.title: The Order
pages.text: They came in order, each needing the last. The $(l:basics/distortion_chamber)matrix$() made energy, $(l:energy/wormholes)wormholes$() carried it, the $(l:machines/condensator)condensator$() made distortion fluid, and from that fluid came the shards and the lattice.
A bucket of distortion fluid soaks four amethyst shards. The bucket comes back. The shards never do.
Shards and gold set in blackstone. Every later core grows from one. Each core's own recipe waits in its chapter.
